title: ITEM rePAIR+
description: Repair any damaged item by right-clicking with Iron Ingot (+5%), Diamond (+10%) or Emerald (+15%).
body:
# Item Repair+

A simple utility mod that lets you repair any damaged item using common materials — no anvil needed.

## How to use

1. Place the item you want to repair in **slot 1** of your inventory
2. Hold a repair material in your hand
3. **Right-click** to restore durability

## Repair materials

| Material | Durability restored |
|---|:---:|
| 🔩 Iron Ingot | +5% |
| 💎 Diamond | +10% |
| 💚 Emerald | +15% |

## Requirements

- Minecraft **1.21.1**
- NeoForge **21.1.x**
